criteria.text: Each of the three selling-turn guards has its own declaration, so no member inherits a stricter mode from a bundle; the additive company question applies again and raises no flag.

The measured question fold applies deterministically again, under an executable proof that only the reply's own asks were dropped; when the proof fails the guard edits nothing and raises a flag for the judge.
The protected 60-output replay produces the same aggregate digest before and after the change, run from a tracked entry point rather than by hand, and no paid call is made.
